title: 海克斯大乱斗
description:
[h1] Public Edition [/h1]
This item supports the default (public) branch of Slay the Spire 2. If you play on the [b]beta branch[/b], please subscribe to the Beta edition instead:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3758775855

[h1] Supported Languages [/h1]
English
简体中文
한국어 (Contributors: 我有幸福症, oatone, Nark)
Español
日本語
Português do Brasil (Contributor: floca)
ภาษาไทย
Русский (Contributor: Dragon enjoyer)

[h1] Introduction [/h1]
This mod adds a Hextech Rune system inspired by League of Legends to Slay the Spire 2. It is a popular large-scale expansion mod for Slay the Spire 2.

There are currently 300+ Hextech Runes with a wide variety of effects. On each floor, you choose one random Hextech Rune, while monsters also randomly gain a Hextech of the same rarity — both sides then fight under ever-changing rules.

The mod also adds character-specific Hextechs, stat forgers, brand-new cards, and statistics feedback, giving every run a different build direction and challenge pacing.

changeNote:
海斗 0.8.5 热修（正式分支 / 0.107.1）：
【修复】感受燃烧/升级：暴露剥除怪物机制类buff（幽灵鳗惊惧等）导致回合卡死；佩尔之眼额外回合使“每回合一次”类效果双触发（量子计算/奏鸣曲/瓦库之肩/据为己有/蛇咬/超凡入圣/神圣干涉/霜灵及6个怪物海克斯）；炽燃利息不再计入无限血演出怪（瀑布怪十亿血阶段）的灼烧转化；升级：虚空形态开局自动打出不再结束你的首回合（已在描述标注）。
【调整】升级：狂宴改为加法计算（两次触发为+30%而非复利1.3225倍）；百分比血量锻造器（7.5%/15%/30%）改为系数加算、不再复利叠乘；升级：墨宝滑溜层数联机按玩家数放大（N/2N/3N，选择界面实时显示实际层数）；升级：墨影幻灵改按联机缩放后的最终血量结算，层数不再因人数额外翻倍。
